item.description: HH Radhanath Swami relays the essential message of Bhagavad GitaGita Jayanti marks the divine day when Lord Sri Krishna spoke the sacred Bhagavad Gita to Arjuna on the battlefield of Kurukshetra. item.description: Bhagavad Gita from Bhismadeva's Perspective. item.description: By Seva Devi Dasi Devotees are not ordinary booksellers; their bookselling is transcendental. It is sankirtana, the glorification of Krsna, the Supreme Personality of Godhead. Sankirtana can be executed very easily, without great endeavor or expense. One can simply chant the Hare Krsna mantra by himself or with others.
